title: Ethereal Creamy French Egg Noodles Cream Puff Paste
description: Indulge in the rich, buttery taste of France with these heavenly egg noodles, light as a cloud, paired with a delicate cream puff filling.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles until al dente, about 6 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the milk, butter, flour, sugar, eggs, and salt.
Whisk the mixture over medium heat until it thickens and forms a smooth paste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with the cream puff filling.
Brush the tops with a little bit of vegetable oil and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow the dish to cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the egg noodles into 1-inch pieces and arrange on a serving plate.
Drizzle with confectioners' sugar and serve immediately.
